content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Legacy payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are great, but they come with limitations. When a platform fails, your business fails. But with a sovereign infrastructure, you're not dependent on a third-party service. You own the code, and you control the flow of payments. This means you can accept payments directly from your customers, without the need for intermediaries like Stripe. And when a platform fails, your business keeps running – unaffected.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy, you'll need a few tools. You'll need Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. You'll also need a NOWPayments account for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Don't worry about the costs – these tools are free or low-cost, and they're worth it for the sovereignty they provide.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers backend. This will allow you to verify on-chain payments and trigger automated delivery of your digital products. To do this, you'll need to create a new worker that listens for incoming payments, then triggers a delivery process using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. It's a straightforward process, and NOWPayments provides detailed documentation to guide you through it.
With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in under 1 minute, compared to 3-5 business days for PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your pipeline is set up, it's time to go live. This involves configuring your domains, setting up your payment gateways, and testing your delivery process. With NOWPayments, you'll be able to accept payments directly from your customers, without the need for intermediaries like Stripe. And with Cloudflare's end-to-end testing, you can be sure your infrastructure is secure and reliable.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
NOWPayments has a low fee structure, with a flat rate of 0.5% per transaction.

Your Deployment Checklist

To get started with setting up your NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, follow these steps: Set up your Cloudflare Pages account and create a new worker. Integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers backend using the NOWPayments API. Configure your domains and set up your payment gateways. Test your delivery process using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Monitor your Supabase database and optimize your Cloudflare Workers for high performance.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the cost of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments has a low fee structure, with a flat rate of 0.5% per transaction. This is significantly lower than many other payment platforms, making it an attractive option for businesses of all sizes.
How do I set up my Cloudflare Workers backend?
To set up your Cloudflare Workers backend, follow the instructions provided by Cloudflare. This will walk you through the process of creating a new worker and integrating it with NOWPayments.
What is the difference between USDT and other cryptocurrencies?

USDT is a stablecoin that is pegged to the value of the US dollar. This makes it a more stable option for businesses that need to accept payments in a fiat currency. Other cryptocurrencies, such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, are more volatile and may not be suitable for all businesses.
How do I convert cryptocurrency to fiat currency?

To convert cryptocurrency to fiat currency, you can use a cryptocurrency exchange like Binance or Coinbase. These services will allow you to buy and sell cryptocurrencies, as well as convert them to fiat currency.
What is the advantage of using NOWPayments over other payment platforms?

NOWPayments has a number of advantages over other payment platforms, including its ease of use, low fees, and high-volume transaction handling capabilities. Additionally, NOWPayments provides a range of features that are not available on other payment platforms, such as automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
Can I use NOWPayments to accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies?

Yes, NOWPayments allows you to accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT, TRON, and Bitcoin. This makes it an attractive option for businesses that need to accept payments in a variety of currencies.
